summary: Implemented Phase 5 rule filtering + addressed code review F1–F6 fixes.

Output_Writer.write() now writes evaluator-clean variant when WRITE_EVALUATOR_CLEAN=True

Keeps rules with empty trade_log (no trades to judge)
Minimum rule safeguard: won't drop below PHASE3_GLOBAL_MIN_RULES

tests_added: - Basic removal (rules with net positive/negative PnL)

No changes to data splitter, Phase 1, Phase 2, or RB Governor

All 29 tests pass (21 original + 8 new rule-filtering tests)
